public_rationale: Korean reporting documents substantial losses in some retirement investments during the semiconductor selloff. That is meaningful evidence in the forecast's direction. It does not establish how many people's overall retirements were wrecked or isolate the claimed cause. Fidelity's account data concern a different population and earlier period. With no deadline and no decisive event meeting the full rule, the forecast remains open.
limitations: The Korean reports use AI-translated English text and include individual examples and online accounts.
Average account balances can conceal severe losses for particular savers.
A large drawdown need not permanently impair retirement security.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The collapse of the AI bubble will wreck many people's retirements.

statement.excerpt: I hate that so many people will see their retirements wrecked, and that so many people intentionally or accidentally helped steer the market in this reckless, needless and wasteful direction, all because big tech didn’t have a new way to show quarterly growth.
statement.document_title: The Hater's Guide To The AI Bubble

from_speaker: all because big tech didn’t have a new way to show quarterly growth
our_interpretation: The plain reading is widespread, severe damage to retirement security caused by the predicted AI-market collapse.
Losses in an individual investment are relevant but do not automatically establish that an entire retirement has been wrecked.
No country is expressly specified, so relevant evidence is not restricted to American accounts.
The collapse is part of the predicted causal sequence, not an expressly stated conditional antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Retirement-account or pension evidence documents severe losses affecting many people and materially impairing retirement security, with credible attribution to an AI-market collapse.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A completed, identifiable AI-collapse episode with comprehensive evidence of no widespread severe retirement damage would count against that episode-specific prediction. Healthy accounts before any final deadline cannot disprove the unrestricted forecast.

evidence.locator: Reporter section, paragraph following the retirement investor's quotation
evidence.explanation: This supports the occurrence of retirement losses during the semiconductor downturn. It does not quantify how many retirements were severely impaired or establish the complete AI-collapse causal chain.

evidence.locator: Opening paragraph, individual retirement pension example
evidence.explanation: The reported semiconductor investment in an individual retirement pension suffered a substantial loss. One investment's return does not measure the person's total retirement resources or establish widespread ruined retirements.

evidence.locator: Women reach new retirement savings milestones
evidence.explanation: This American account subgroup had higher average balances before the reported Korean July losses. It supplies context, not a contradiction of losses elsewhere or of an open-ended forecast.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Representative pension or account records documenting widespread severe retirement impairment, linked through credible analysis to an identifiable AI-market collapse.
